description: This file defines a set of reusable Card UI components in React, including the main Card component with polymorphic 'as' support, and auxiliary components such as CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent, and CardFooter, each with styling and flexible props.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A polymorphic React component for rendering a container element with predefined classes, supporting different HTML tags via the 'as' prop.

methods.name: CardHeader
methods.description: A React functional component representing the header section of a card, styled with margin bottom.

methods.name: CardTitle
methods.description: A React functional component for the card's title with specific typography styles.

methods.name: CardContent
methods.description: A React functional component for the main content area of the card.

methods.name: CardFooter
methods.description: A React functional component for the footer section of the card, styled with top margin and border.
